full.alt: Without a ranking priority, the current restaurant Decision summary presents two passing complete repairs: Rowan at $836 remaining payroll and the coordinated repair at $736.
full.caption: Rowan can work 6–10 p.m. Two supplied repairs pass; Compare without ranking declares neither preferred.

blockers.alt: All repairs inspects Move Theo only and identifies the unfilled Sunday cooking position among its unmet requirements.
blockers.caption: Moving Theo fills Saturday but leaves Sunday short. Inspect the complete repair rather than just the replacement name.

process.alt: The restaurant Decision process graph connects complete-repair assessment to passing repairs, optional priority, revision and external staff agreement, with labeled current-case and reassessment paths.
process.caption: The graph shows how the finding changes the available response. Inspection does not obtain staff agreement or publish a roster.

stale.alt: After Rowan’s earlier finish is applied, the Decision summary withholds the earlier answer and calls for a current calculation.
stale.caption: Applying a changed availability withdraws the previous finding. Recalculate before relying on the comparison.

short.alt: With Rowan available only 6–8 p.m., the unranked restaurant Decision summary shows only the coordinated repair passing at $736 remaining payroll.
short.caption: Only Rowan’s finish changes. The required assignment still runs until 10 p.m.; the coordinated repair remains feasible.

stability.alt: Preserve published assignments first prefers Bring in Rowan, with $836 remaining payroll, $180 additional expense and one changed position.
stability.caption: Stability first: Rowan preserves the other published assignments. Payroll breaks ties after the changed-position count.

cost.alt: Minimize remaining payroll first prefers Repair three assignments, with $736 remaining payroll, $80 additional expense and three changed positions.
cost.caption: Cost first: the coordinated repair saves $100. Every staffing requirement and operating fact stays the same.

roster.alt: Complete roster displays all nine Friday dinner, Saturday dinner and Sunday lunch assignments for the Rowan repair, with employees and readable start and finish times.
roster.caption: Inspect the nine-position remaining roster before discussing it with staff. Rowan covers Saturday’s entire cooking assignment; the other published assignments remain.
